title: Watch launch

fields.label: Page name
fields.help: Brand and model, e.g. Holm & Rye Field 38.

fields.label: The watch
fields.help: Model, calibre, case size and thickness, water resistance, power reserve, what is printed on the dial. The page shows a hand-wound three-hand watch.

fields.label: Cases, dials and straps
fields.help: Three case metals, four dials and four straps with prices and lead times.

fields.label: How people order
fields.help: Deposit, delivery slots or allocation, how many you make.

fields.label: How should the page sound?
fields.help: A few words about the brand.

writerNotes: The watch is a fixed drawing of a three-hand, hand-wound watch (no rotor) that comes apart in six stages as you scroll, showing a movement that beats at 4 Hz (28,800 vph); the winding demo runs 72 hours from 40 crown turns. If the brand's watch is automatic, a chronograph or very different, ask with _blocked whether this design fits rather than misdescribing it.

hero.stages are the six stages' titles and captions in order: assembled, crystal off, dial and hands, going train, escapement, back together; numbers in them (case size, thickness, water resistance, jewels) are facts from the brief. hero.firstText is the first caption as the page first shows it (normally the same as stages[0].text). hero.pills are three short facts (jewels, power reserve, frequency).
brand.dialName, watch.dialModel, watch.dialSub, watch.dialSub2 and watch.engraving are printed on the drawn dial and movement, in capitals (dialModel in italic, normal case): keep them short.

configure: three case metals (they are drawn as steel, titanium and gold, in that order), four dials (drawn rhodium, ink, moss, enamel) and four straps (drawn tan, cordovan, suede, oxblood). Name them as the brand does, choosing options whose look matches those finishes; prices are whole numbers, the first dial and strap are included (price 0); each case has a lead time in weeks.

specs.rows are exactly twelve rows: lengths as mm numbers (the page converts them to inches and lignes), text values, and one row with water: true for water resistance (specs.water gives metres and bar). Only facts from the brief.
reserve: how people order (eyebrow, title, three delivery options, the button with any deposit, and how a held slot is described, e.g. 'slot 41 of 140').
theme.wordmarkFit: always "fit" for a new brand. footer.fine is a one-line note.
business.name is set to exactly the name in the brief and cannot be changed.
